title: Self Gradient Forcing reproduction: gradient path, two-pass fidelity/memory, and matched bounded training on Wan2.1-1.3B
description: All three central claims reproduced on the released framewise implementation: future-loss gradients reach KV-cache writing only under SGF, pass-2 replay matches the serial rollout to 1.33% rel-L2 while naive differentiable rollouts OOM a 96GB GPU, and a matched 250-step budget differing by one config line gives SGF 0.829 vs 0.675 DINO subject consistency at 240s over frozen-cache Self Forcing.
